findings.title: Gazans harvest dregs of olive groves bulldozed and cut off by Israel
findings.affected_population_or_system: Olive producers, agricultural livelihoods, food production and access to olive oil
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Gaza's agriculture authorities estimate that of 2 million olive trees, barely 150,000 are still standing.
findings.summary: Reuters' October 14 field report offers newly reported current harvest-capacity estimates: approximately 150,000 of 2 million olive trees remain; anticipated olive harvest around 5,000 tons rather than roughly 40,000 normally; seven presses operate versus about 40 before the war. Groves are damaged and partly inaccessible beyond a military boundary. These are attributed estimates and observed ongoing effects, not proof of a new attack within the hourly window.
